advisor.description: Use Fable 5 for quick, independent technical advice, architecture and design decisions, tradeoff analysis, planning, and challenging assumptions. Do not use for implementation.

build.description: Use for implementing code changes, running focused verification, and reporting completed work.

explore.description: Use for focused codebase exploration, tracing behavior, locating relevant files, and reporting implementation findings. Do not modify files.

review-anthropic.description: Use Claude Opus 5 for code review focused on correctness bugs, regressions, architectural and call-graph changes, performance and resource-use regressions, A Philosophy of Software Design (APOSD) red flags, design risks, and missing tests.

review-openai.description: Use GPT-5.6 Sol for code review focused on correctness bugs, regressions, architectural and call-graph changes, performance and resource-use regressions, A Philosophy of Software Design (APOSD) red flags, design risks, and missing tests.

research.description: Use for web access: search authoritative sources for current documentation, release notes, pricing, and news, or fetch and extract content from a specific URL. Runs through an isolated Codex child so raw web content stays out of the parent context.
